A1.justification: Both PDFs describe T2I-R1 and BiCoT-GRPO. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison. v1 ends with references; v2 includes readable Appendices A–C and additional visualizations.

before.justification: v1 reports original T2I-CompBench and WISE evaluations, reward and CoT ablations, a human study, and image-diversity results.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and adds GenAI-Bench, TIIF-Bench Testmini, and qualitative zero-shot semantic-CoT comparisons.

M1.justification: The semantic-then-token generation pipeline, joint BiCoT-GRPO objective, Janus-Pro backbone, and reward ensemble are unchanged. The added zero-shot pipeline is an experimental comparator, not a revision to T2I-R1.

E1.justification: Appendix A and Tables 5–6 add GenAI-Bench and TIIF-Bench Testmini to the retained benchmarks. Coverage expands to professional designer prompts, counting, comparison, logical conditions, and fine-grained instruction following involving style and text rendering. Training-data coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 5–6 introduce evaluated comparators absent from v1's comparisons, including Midjourney v6, LWM, Liquid, UniTok, Mogao-7B, LlamaGen, LightGen, and Infinity. Figures 9–12 also add Janus-Pro with zero-shot semantic-level CoT. Comparator membership in Tables 1–4 remains unchanged.

E3.justification: Added evaluations introduce TIIF-Bench Testmini with short/long-prompt reporting, GenAI-Bench basic/advanced aggregates, and a control applying T2I-R1's generation pipeline to unmodified Janus-Pro. Existing experimental settings are retained; newly disclosed training parameters and participant counts do not establish changes to those experiments.

E4.justification: Appendix B.2 and Figures 9–12 add a focused qualitative analysis of whether zero-shot semantic planning suffices without BiCoT-GRPO training. Figures 8 and 13–14 extend visual ablation and diversity examples. The quantitative reward and CoT ablations remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports evaluation confidence intervals, error bars, significance tests, or uncertainty across training runs. The ten-images-per-prompt Vendi-score procedure already appears in v1 and is retained. Additional human-study participant information does not introduce uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 retain their numerical results. New Table 5 reports T2I-R1 GenAI-Bench basic/advanced overall scores of 0.88/0.73 versus Janus-Pro's 0.84/0.65. New Table 6 reports TIIF-Bench short/long overall scores of 68.59/67.19 versus 66.50/65.02. These are added evaluations, not improvements over v1 under retained settings.

T1.justification: The CoT definitions, GRPO objective, probability ratios, and reward equations retain their mathematical content. Equation numbering and placement change, but no substantive definitions, derivations, assumptions, or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the dual-level reasoning contribution, joint optimization claim, and headline 13%/19% benchmark improvements. Revised contribution wording and additional supporting evaluations do not materially redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Appendix B.2 adds explanations for zero-shot planning failures: omitted objects and plans poorly matched to generation capabilities. Appendix C newly discusses obstacles to video extension, including reward design, suitable unified models, and GRPO computational costs. Existing interpretations of planning, diversity, and ensemble rewards are retained.

D1.justification: Appendices B.3–B.4 substantially expand reproducibility information: eight graduate raters, visual-appeal-only ranking instructions, eight H800 GPUs, approximately 16 hours of training, and Table 7's training steps, batch/group sizes, accumulation, guidance scale, gradient clipping, and resolution. These are newly documented details; the code address remains unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references supporting the new benchmarks and comparators, including GenAI-Bench, TIIF-Bench, Mogao, UniTok, and LightGen. The related-work narrative and novelty positioning remain substantially unchanged. Citation renumbering and duplicate-reference adjustments do not constitute additional research-positioning changes.

P1.justification: The experimental narrative is substantially reorganized: setup moves from Section 4.1 to Appendix A, and detailed ablation and human-study explanations move to Appendix B while the main discussion is condensed. Appendices organize results, implementation information, and limitations. Local terminology edits also distinguish detector D from ORM O.

P2.justification: Figure 5 is reformatted, v1 Figure 6 is split across v2 Figures 6–7, and existing chameleon examples move to Figure 8. New Tables 5–7 and additional qualitative displays, especially Figures 9–14, substantially expand the visual presentation. Tables 1–4 preserve their numerical content.

improvement.justification: v2 substantially addresses v1's sparse reproducibility documentation and limited evaluation coverage through Table 7, compute and human-study details, and two additional benchmarks. The same-pipeline zero-shot control also helps assess the contribution of training beyond prompt planning. That control remains qualitative, statistical uncertainty remains absent, and the GRPO equation reference becomes incorrect, but these limitations do not outweigh the substantial gains in documentation and empirical scrutiny.
